_comment: Sieve — AI Blocker: curated, STATIC domain lists (like dating-sites.json and
game-sites.json). Three INDEPENDENT groups, each with its own toggle and its
own DNR ID band, so a user can block homework/humanizer tools without losing
ChatGPT, or block AI companions without touching either.
This is NOT the same thing as the Safety Shield's 'AI content farms' toggle.
That one blocks sites whose PAGES are mass-produced AI slop; this one blocks
the AI TOOLS themselves, and it is self-control rather than safety — the
blocked page says 'you chose to block…' and never warns or moralises.
SCOPE DECISIONS worth keeping (each one is a deliberate omission):
• Chat PRODUCT domains only, never a vendor's parent domain where the two
differ. requestDomains matches a listed domain AND all its subdomains, so
'openai.com' would take api.openai.com and platform.openai.com with it and
break any page calling the API. Hence chatgpt.com, not openai.com;
gemini.google.com, not google.com; chat.mistral.ai, not mistral.ai.
• Search engines' built-in AI answers (Google AI Overviews, Bing) cannot be
reached by a domain blocker at all — blocking the search engine is the only
lever, and that is the user's own Blocked-sites list, not this.
• Coding assistants wired into an IDE (GitHub Copilot, Cursor) are left out:
Copilot answers from github.com, which no one can block without losing
the repos. Web coding CHATS (Phind, Blackbox) are in, since they are a
browser tab like any other.
• Image / video / voice GENERATORS (Midjourney, Runway, ElevenLabs) are not
covered by any group here. The user's own Blocked sites list covers them.
• Grammarly is deliberately absent from 'writing': it is a proofreader first,
and blocking it would cost far more than the AI writing it has grown.
• Human essay mills (Chegg, Course Hero) are absent too — they are not AI,
and a toggle named for AI should not quietly take them.
• Explicit AI porn generators are out of scope here, exactly as the dating
tier leaves hardcore sites to the separate porn blocker. 'companions' is
the roleplay/girlfriend chat apps, which is where the compulsion lives.
Hand-curated from known brands — NOT fetched, NO scheduler. Editing this file
+ reloading the extension rebuilds the rules. Every domain here resolved when
the list was reviewed; a dead one costs nothing but a wasted rule entry.
The shared Allowlist (priority 2, ID 20000) overrides every rule built here.
